relationship_to_v1: V1 remains the official broad benchmark mapping. V2 is a post-evaluation product-scope view for analysing the same saved predictions against labels SafePaste actually claims to handle.

policy.invalid_spans: Exclude invalid gold spans during normalized evaluation and report their counts.
policy.overlapping_gold_spans: Preserve spans during audit; normalized evaluation must use one-to-one matching.
policy.scope: English support-text PII before AI upload: names, email, phone, IP addresses, direct address components, local government identifiers and financial identifiers when present.

BOD.reason: Temporal attribute outside the current SafePaste detector scope.

BUILDING.reason: Direct address component relevant to support-text review.

CITY.reason: City alone is treated as broad location context rather than direct PII in the V2 product-scope view.

COUNTRY.reason: Country alone is too broad for the V2 support-text PII scope.

DATE.reason: General dates are outside the current SafePaste PII scope.

DRIVERLICENSE.reason: Generic multi-country driver licence formats are a documented V1 coverage gap and are reserved for a future recognizer pack.

GEOCOORD.reason: Precise coordinates can reveal a specific location.

IDCARD.reason: Generic multi-country ID-card formats are a documented V1 coverage gap and are reserved for a future recognizer pack.

IP.reason: IP addresses are structured network identifiers.

PASS.reason: Passwords are credentials; this project reports credentials as outside the PII detector scope.

PASSPORT.reason: Generic multi-country passport formats are a documented V1 coverage gap and are reserved for a future recognizer pack.

POSTCODE.reason: Postal codes are direct address components in support text.

SECADDRESS.reason: Secondary address fields are direct address components.

SEX.reason: Demographic attributes are outside the current direct-PII detector scope.

SOCIALNUMBER.reason: Generic social-number formats are a documented V1 coverage gap and are reserved for a future recognizer pack.

STATE.reason: State or region alone is treated as broad location context in the V2 product-scope view.

STREET.reason: Street fields are direct address components.

TIME.reason: Standalone times are outside the current SafePaste PII scope.

TITLE.reason: Honorifics or job titles alone are not treated as PII in this scope.

USERNAME.reason: Account usernames are outside the current detector scope and are reported as a limitation.
